exercises.name: Hooklying diaphragmatic breathing
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands on the lower ribs.
Breathe into belly and lower ribs; shoulders stay relaxed.
Do not force the back flat.
exercises.stop_if: Dizziness, or any rise in familiar back symptoms.
exercises.contraindications: Not in the first 45-60 min after waking. Floor transfers wait until the morning window has passed.

exercises.name: Neutral-spine positioning (hooklying)
cues: Find a comfortable mid-range lumbar position (small natural curve).
Tighten the abdominals lightly, hold 2 s, release; repeat.
Never an aggressive tilt or flattening of the back.
exercises.stop_if: Pain, or any pull at end range.
exercises.contraindications: Not in the first 45-60 min after waking. This is motor-control practice, not a stretch.

exercises.name: Standing brace practice
cues: Stand tall, ribs stacked over pelvis, natural low-back curve.
Stiffen the midsection to about 20-30% effort, as if bracing for a light poke in the stomach.
Do not suck in or push out; keep breathing normally.
exercises.stop_if: Breath-holding, dizziness, or back symptoms.
exercises.contraindications: Light brace only; no hard Valsalva.

exercises.name: Cat-camel (mid-range only)
cues: On hands and knees, slowly round and then gently arch in the middle of the range.
You are moving, not stretching; stop well short of either end.
exercises.stop_if: Any pull, pinch or pressure at the ends of range.
exercises.contraindications: Not in the first 45-60 min after waking. Optional warm-up only; never pushed to end range; drop it if it increases symptoms.

exercises.name: Planned decompression rest (90/90)
cues: Lie on your back with calves resting on a chair or couch so hips and knees sit near 90 degrees.
Breathe slowly; let the back soften. 3-5 min. Do not lengthen this on purpose.
exercises.stop_if: If lying down does not ease symptoms, log it as an oddity and try a standing alternative.
exercises.contraindications: Preferred decompression in each work posture cycle (not a single break at hour 2.5-3). The goal is to need it less often, not for longer.

exercises.name: Side-lying rest with pillow
cues: Lie on your side with a pillow between the knees; hips and knees comfortably bent.
Breathe slowly for 3-10 min.
exercises.stop_if: None.
exercises.contraindications: None.

exercises.name: Prone on elbows (decompression alternative)
cues: Lie face down and prop on your elbows, hips relaxed on the floor, legs long.
Breathe; stay only if this clearly feels good. This is a rest position, not a repeated press-up.
exercises.stop_if: Any increase in back symptoms, or any buttock or leg symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Optional alternative during the work-cycle decompression if 90/90 is not available or this feels better. Skip it if extension bothers you.

exercises.name: Standing extension (work-friendly reset)
cues: Stand tall, hands on your hips or low back, and gently lean back a little, not to end range.
Take a few slow breaths, then return to tall standing.
exercises.stop_if: Any increase in back symptoms, or any buttock or leg symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Use when you cannot lie down at work. Gentle only; not a stretch to push.

exercises.name: Door-frame hang (feet on the floor)
cues: Hold the top or sides of a sturdy door frame, keep both feet on the floor, and let the shoulders and back gently unload.
Bend the knees a little; do not hang from the hands only. Breathe for 3-5 min, or as long as is comfortable within that range.
exercises.stop_if: Shoulder pain, wrist pain, or any increase in back symptoms.
exercises.contraindications: Use when you cannot lie down at work. This is not a pull-up dead hang; feet stay on the floor.

exercises.name: Single knee-to-chest (relief only)
cues: Lie on your back; gently draw one knee toward the chest, other leg supported (not hanging).
Hold 10 s, 3-5 reps, only if it eases symptoms; stop short of end range.
exercises.stop_if: Any compressive feeling, pinch, sharp or electrical pain.
exercises.contraindications: Flexion drill: relief only, later in the day, never in the first 45-60 min after waking, never counted toward the checklist, never pushed to end range. Drop it if it does not clearly help.

exercises.name: Inversion table
cues: Use the inversion table's supports and straps as the manufacturer describes, and stay within a comfortable angle.
Stay inverted for 2-5 minutes, then come back upright slowly. Stop if symptoms increase.
exercises.stop_if: Any increase in back, buttock, or leg symptoms, dizziness, or discomfort coming back upright.
exercises.contraindications: A rest position only, for 2-5 minutes. Come up slowly. Skip it if it does not clearly feel okay.

exercises.name: Standing calf stretch
cues: Hands on wall, back leg straight, heel down, trunk upright.
20 s per side, mild.
exercises.stop_if: Any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Spine stays tall; spares the lumbar spine. Optional.

exercises.name: Supine strap hamstring stretch
cues: Lie on your back, low back resting in its natural position, strap around the foot.
Raise the leg until a mild hamstring stretch; 2 x 20-30 s per side.
exercises.stop_if: Pull into the buttock or leg, or low-back pressure.
exercises.contraindications: Only if hamstrings feel specifically tight and it causes zero lasting symptoms. Replaces the elevated (foot-on-step) version.

exercises.name: Figure-4 hip stretch (supine, mild)
cues: On your back, ankle over opposite knee; draw in only until a mild hip stretch.
Low back stays on the floor; 2 x 20-30 s per side; evening only.
exercises.stop_if: Low-back rounding or pull, or any buttock/leg symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Optional comfort tool only; skip if it feels like a back stretch.

exercises.name: Side-lying quad stretch
cues: Lie on your side, hips stacked, hold the top ankle, lightly squeeze the glute.
Pelvis stays stacked; do not arch the back; 2 x 20 s per side.
exercises.stop_if: Arching or pinching in the low back.
exercises.contraindications: Replaces the prone strap quad stretch (which can push the back into extension).

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch (upright)
cues: Half-kneel, squeeze the back-leg glute, ribs down, tall spine.
Shift forward only a little; 2 x 20 s per side.
exercises.stop_if: Low-back pinching or arching.
exercises.contraindications: Upright and glute-led; never let the back arch to get more stretch. Optional from L3.

exercises.name: McGill modified curl-up
cues: One knee bent, other leg straight; palms flat under the natural arch of the low back (do not flatten into the floor).
Brace lightly (20-30%). Lift only the head and shoulder blades 1-2 in (a few cm) as one unit, chin neutral.
Hold, breathe, lower; swap the bent leg halfway through.
exercises.stop_if: STOP THE SET if you feel pressure, pinch or pull in the low back, or the back flattens onto your hands. This is not a crunch.
exercises.contraindications: Not in the first 45-60 min after waking. If it reproduces symptoms even with perfect form, drop it and use dead bug instead. Never substitute sit-ups or crunches. Check form on side-view phone video in the first sessions.

exercises.name: McGill curl-up, elbows off the floor
cues: Same setup as the curl-up; lift the elbows a few cm off the floor to increase the load.
Still only head and shoulder blades 1-2 in; no back flattening.
exercises.stop_if: Same as curl-up; also stop if the neck strains.
exercises.contraindications: Same as curl-up. Do not move on to any loaded or full sit-up.

exercises.name: Side bridge from knees
cues: Elbow under shoulder, knees bent 90 degrees; lift hips so knees, hips and shoulders make a line.
Ribs stacked over pelvis; breathe through the hold; no sag or rotation.
exercises.stop_if: Hip sag, rotation, or low-back/shoulder pain.
exercises.contraindications: Shoulder pain: elevate the forearm on a cushion or use a wall-supported version.

exercises.name: Side bridge from feet
cues: Elbow under shoulder, legs straight (feet staggered is fine).
Push hips forward into one line; do not let the top hip roll forward or back.
exercises.stop_if: Hip sag, rotation, or any low-back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Regress to knees at the first sign of sag.

exercises.name: Bird dog
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, neutral spine; brace lightly.
Reach one arm and the opposite leg to body height, no higher; hold; hips stay level (balance a cup on the low back).
Sweep hand and knee gently toward the floor between reps.
exercises.stop_if: Low back arching or pelvis rotating; any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Wrist pain: use fists or forearms. Leg never above hip height.

exercises.name: Bird dog with small square trace
cues: Clenched fist; from the held position trace a small square with hand and foot while the trunk stays still.
Keep the reach at body height.
exercises.stop_if: Any loss of pelvic control or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Same as bird dog.

exercises.name: Brace march (hooklying)
cues: On your back, knees bent; brace lightly.
Lift one foot a few cm, set it down, alternate; no pelvic rocking.
exercises.stop_if: Pelvis rocks or back arches.
exercises.contraindications: None specific. Keeps your current home drill.

exercises.name: Dead bug, heel taps
cues: On your back, hips and knees at 90 degrees, arms up; ribs down, back still.
Slowly lower one heel toward the floor to tap, return; alternate. Only as far as the back stays still.
exercises.stop_if: Back arches off the floor or ribs flare.
exercises.contraindications: Do not rush to fully extended legs.

exercises.name: Dead bug, opposite arm and leg reach
cues: From tabletop, exhale and lower the opposite arm and leg a few inches, 3 s, keeping the back still; return.
Range grows only while the back does not arch.
exercises.stop_if: Back arching, rib flare, any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Stay within the range where the lumbar spine does not move.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof press
cues: Stand sideways to a chest-height cable, handle at the sternum, feet shoulder-width, knees soft.
Press straight out and hold; do not let the torso rotate; return slowly.
exercises.stop_if: Torso twists or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Increase the stack one plate at a time (5 lb), never rotation range. This is your clinic anti-rotation drill, now on the cable stack.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof press with step-out
cues: As the cable Pallof press, but step one pace farther from the stack before the press.
Hips and shoulders stay square.
exercises.stop_if: Torso rotation or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Same as the cable Pallof press.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling cable Pallof press
cues: Half-kneel with the inside knee down, glute squeezed, ribs down, cable handle at the sternum.
Press and hold without rotating or leaning.
exercises.stop_if: Rotation, leaning, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Same as the cable Pallof press.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
cues: Feet flat, knees bent, brace lightly.
Drive through the heels and squeeze glutes until shoulders, hips and knees line up; hold; lower slowly.
Stop before the low back arches.
exercises.stop_if: Low back arching or hamstring cramp; any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Do not hyperextend at the top.

exercises.name: Marching glute bridge
cues: Hold the bridge, lift one foot a few cm, set down, alternate; pelvis stays level.
exercises.stop_if: Pelvis drops or back arches.
exercises.contraindications: Same as glute bridge.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
cues: One foot flat, other knee drawn up (no pull on the lower back); lift with the glute; pelvis level.
exercises.stop_if: Pelvis rotates, back arches, hamstring cramp.
exercises.contraindications: Same as glute bridge.

exercises.name: Hip thrust (upper back on couch/bench)
cues: Upper back on the edge of a couch, feet flat, chin tucked, ribs down.
Drive hips up until hips line up with knees and shoulders; do not arch the low back to get higher.
exercises.stop_if: Back arching, or any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Load only after bodyweight sets are clean; no rib flare.

exercises.name: Banded side-steps
cues: Band just above the knees (easier) or ankles (harder); half-squat, toes forward.
Short controlled steps; shoulders level; trunk quiet. May add arms-out/in as in clinic.
exercises.stop_if: Trunk sway or knee collapse; back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Your clinic drill; keep it.

exercises.name: Banded monster walks (forward/back)
cues: Band above knees or ankles, half-squat, toes forward.
Walk forward and back in short steps without trunk sway.
exercises.stop_if: Trunk sway or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Same as side-steps.

exercises.name: Calf raise
cues: Light hand support; rise slowly, lower for 3 s; trunk tall.
exercises.stop_if: Calf cramp or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: None specific.

exercises.name: Box squat to chair with T-strap or counter support
cues: Hold straps or counter for balance; feet hip-width; push hips back, sit lightly to chair height; stand tall.
Keep chest-to-pelvis angle the same; do not go below chair height.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Low-back rounding at the bottom or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Your clinic T-strap squat, made into a home box squat.

exercises.name: Box squat (chair tap), unsupported
cues: Feet slightly wider than hips; brace; sit hips back to lightly tap the chair without relaxing or rounding.
Stand by driving through the whole foot.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Rounding at the bottom, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Depth is capped where the low back would round.

exercises.name: Goblet box squat
cues: Hold the weight at the chest, elbows in; same box squat mechanics.
Weight goes up only in 5 lb steps.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Rounding, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Start light (5-10 lb) and only after green check-ins.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
cues: Weight at the chest, brace, squat to a depth where the low back stays neutral (not 'butt wink').
Drive up through the heels.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Pelvic tuck/rounding at the bottom, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Depth set by the point where the back would round.

exercises.name: Barbell squat (box, then full)
cues: Bar on the upper back, brace, hips and knees break together; keep chest-to-pelvis angle constant.
Start to a box; always inside safety pins.
Brief brace only, no long strain.
exercises.stop_if: Rounding, shift, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Optional strength-sport item (L7). Requires rack with safeties. Heavy axial load: only after hinge and goblet tests are clean.

exercises.name: Split squat, hand supported
cues: Staggered stance, one hand on a wall or chair; torso tall; lower the back knee straight down; push through the front heel.
Front knee tracks over toes.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Torso leaning forward with back rounding; front-knee pain; back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Upright torso only.

exercises.name: Split squat, loaded
cues: Same as the supported version, holding weights at the sides; no hand support.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Torso lean/rounding or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Load only after bodyweight sets are clean.

exercises.name: Step-up (low, 4-6 in)
cues: Whole foot on the step; drive through the front heel; control the way down; pelvis level.
exercises.stop_if: Pelvic drop, push off the back foot, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Keep steps low until balance tests pass.

exercises.name: Step-up (8-12 in)
cues: Same mechanics on a higher step, optional weights at the sides.
exercises.stop_if: Pelvic drop or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Same as low step-up.

exercises.name: Slow step-down (3 s lowering)
cues: Stand on a step, lower the other foot slowly to tap the floor over 3 s; knee tracks over toes; pelvis level.
exercises.stop_if: Knee collapse, pelvic drop, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Landing-control prerequisite for impact work.

exercises.name: Hip hinge with dowel
cues: Hold a dowel down the spine touching head, upper back and tailbone.
Soften the knees and push hips straight back until you feel hamstring tension or a contact point lifts; squeeze glutes to stand.
exercises.stop_if: A contact point lifts, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Hips move, spine stays neutral.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift from a block (6-8 in)
cues: Bell between feet on a block; hinge back, brace, stand by driving hips forward; do not lean back at the top.
Start light; +5 lb steps only.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Rounding at the bottom, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Stay on the block until floor tests pass.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift from the floor
cues: Same mechanics from floor height.
Return to the block immediately if the back rounds.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Rounding or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Gate: clean block deadlift at target load.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift (hand supported, then free)
cues: One hand on a wall; hinge on one leg, back leg and torso move as one plank; hips stay square.
Keep breathing; no long breath-hold (Valsalva).
exercises.stop_if: Rotation of the pelvis, rounding, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Needs single-leg balance test first.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift from blocks (raised bar)
cues: Bar raised on blocks to about mid-shin; brace, hinge, push the floor away; lock out with glutes.
Brief brace only, no long strain.
exercises.stop_if: Rounding, bar drifting forward, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: No heavy lifting alone without a safe bail-out plan.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift from the floor
cues: Bar over mid-foot, hinge, brace, push the floor away; no hitching or leaning back.
Brief brace only, no long strain.
exercises.stop_if: Rounding or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Raise the bar again at the first sign of rounding.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
cues: Hinge, hike the bell back, snap the hips forward; arms are hooks, the bell floats to chest height.
Spine stays neutral throughout.
Brief brace only, no long strain.
exercises.stop_if: Any rounding, any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Ballistic hinge: L7 or later and only with clean floor deadlifts.

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl (eccentric)
cues: Kneel, ankles anchored; lower the torso as slowly as you can in a straight line from knees to head; catch with hands.
exercises.stop_if: Back symptom or hamstring pain.
exercises.contraindications: Sprint-preparation hamstring work; start with short ranges.

exercises.name: Floor-to-waist practice lift
cues: Hinge or squat to the load, hold it close, brace, stand tall; turn with the feet.
exercises.stop_if: Rounding or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Everyday-lift practice, same rules as deadlifts.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
cues: Hands at chest height on a wall, body in a straight line, ribs down; lower chest to the wall with elbows ~45 degrees.
exercises.stop_if: Back sag or symptoms.
exercises.contraindications: None specific.

exercises.name: Incline push-up (counter/bench)
cues: Hands on an elevated surface, body straight from head to heels; brace; lower the chest under control.
exercises.stop_if: Back sag or symptoms.
exercises.contraindications: Lower the incline in small steps.

exercises.name: Push-up
cues: Hands under shoulders, body straight, ribs down, glutes on; chest to just above the floor.
exercises.stop_if: Hips sag or pike, or any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Use incline if the trunk cannot hold a plank line.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
cues: Lie on the floor, knees bent, feet flat; press from elbows resting on the floor; back stays in its natural position.
exercises.stop_if: Back arching or shoulder pain.
exercises.contraindications: Floor limits shoulder range and back arching.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Feet flat on the floor, shoulder blades set, small natural arch only; lower with control; press up.
exercises.stop_if: Excess low-back arching, shoulder pain, or any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Feet planted; no exaggerated arch.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
cues: Feet planted, shoulder blades set, bar path over the shoulders; control down, press up.
Always inside safeties or with a spotter.
exercises.stop_if: Back arching, shoulder pain, or any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Never bench alone without safeties or a spotter.

exercises.name: Standing cable row
cues: Stand tall facing the cable stack; pull the handle back toward the hip and squeeze the shoulder blade; trunk stays still.
exercises.stop_if: Trunk sway or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: None specific. Use the cable stack (5–55 lb).

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row (supported)
cues: Hand and knee on a bench, flat back, pull the elbow toward the hip; no trunk rotation.
exercises.stop_if: Rotation, rounding, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Support the torso; no unsupported bent-over rows early on.

exercises.name: Inverted row (table or low bar)
cues: Body straight, heels on the floor, pull the chest to the bar; hips stay up.
exercises.stop_if: Hips sag or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Check the table/bar is strong enough.

exercises.name: Dead hang (scapula set)
cues: Hang from a bar with a gentle shoulder-blade set; no swinging or twisting.
Step down; do not drop.
exercises.stop_if: Shoulder pain, swinging, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Optional; no swinging or twisting; feet-supported if needed.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up / slow lowering
cues: Band or box under the feet; pull the chest to the bar; lower for 3 s.
Ribs down, no swinging.
exercises.stop_if: Swinging, back arching, shoulder pain.
exercises.contraindications: Use a lighter band step by step.

exercises.name: Pull-up
cues: Full hang, ribs down, pull the chest to the bar; no kipping.
exercises.stop_if: Swinging, arching, shoulder pain, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Strict only.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry (one weight)
cues: Stand tall with one weight; do not lean away; shoulders level; walk slowly.
exercises.stop_if: Leaning or hip hike; back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Light start; anti-lateral-flexion drill.

exercises.name: Farmer carry (two weights)
cues: Tall posture, braced, short controlled steps; weights close to the body.
exercises.stop_if: Leaning or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Same as suitcase carry.

exercises.name: Walking (comfortable pace)
cues: Flat route, upright posture, natural arm swing, comfortable stride.
Split into two bouts before cutting the total.
exercises.stop_if: Leg symptoms, sharp pain, or a limp.
exercises.contraindications: Daily; the backbone of the plan.

exercises.name: Brisk walking intervals
cues: Alternate 2 min brisk with 2 min easy; gentle hills only if flat walking is clean the next day.
exercises.stop_if: Any symptom increase.
exercises.contraindications: Hills only after flat walks are green.

exercises.name: Marching drills (tall posture)
cues: Tall posture, brace lightly, opposite arm and knee drive to hip height, quiet landings.
exercises.stop_if: Heavy landings or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: First step of the impact ladder.

exercises.name: Low skips
cues: Small, light, rhythmic skips on the balls of the feet; relaxed trunk.
exercises.stop_if: Stiff or heavy landings, or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Stop if landings feel jarring.

exercises.name: Step-off soft landing
cues: Step off a low box (6-8 in) and land softly on both feet, hips back, knees tracking, chest tall; stick for 2 s.
exercises.stop_if: Stiff landing, knee collapse, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Landing skill before any jumping.

exercises.name: Pogo hops (small ankle hops)
cues: Stiff ankles, tiny hops, tall posture, minimal knee bend; quick, quiet contacts.
exercises.stop_if: Jarring or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Low amplitude; stop at the first jarring landing.

exercises.name: Line hops (forward/back and side-to-side)
cues: Hop over a line with both feet, quick contacts, soft knees, tall trunk.
exercises.stop_if: Jarring landings or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Low amplitude.

exercises.name: Single-leg hops in place
cues: Hop on one leg in place, small amplitude, stick or rebound, pelvis level.
exercises.stop_if: Jarring, pelvic drop, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Needs balance and step-down tests first.

exercises.name: Walk-jog intervals
cues: Alternate jog and walk (e.g. 1:2, then 1:1, then 2:1); conversational pace; short quiet steps.
exercises.stop_if: Jarring or any symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Soft surfaces; not on consecutive days at first.

exercises.name: Continuous jog
cues: Easy conversational pace; tall posture; quiet landings.
exercises.stop_if: Any symptom increase, or leg symptoms.
exercises.contraindications: Separate from heavy hinge days.

exercises.name: Strides (relaxed accelerations)
cues: Build smoothly to 70-80% over 60 m, hold relaxed, then ease off; walk back.
exercises.stop_if: Pulling in the hamstring, or any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Gentle build, relaxed shoulders.

exercises.name: Acceleration runs (20-30 m)
cues: Lean forward, drive the arms and legs, rise gradually to upright; 80-90% effort first.
Football start: a short stance and first-step drive; soccer: the first 20-30 m of a break.
exercises.stop_if: Hamstring or groin pain, or any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Warm up thoroughly. Football and soccer both use this as the acceleration base.

exercises.name: Low box jump (12-18 in) with step-down
cues: Jump up, land softly with hips back; step down, do not jump down.
exercises.stop_if: Hard landing, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Step down every rep.

exercises.name: Broad jump (stick landing)
cues: Swing the arms, jump forward, land softly on both feet and hold 2 s.
exercises.stop_if: Hard landing, rounding, or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Stick every landing.

exercises.name: Lateral bounds (skater jumps)
cues: Bound sideways from one leg to the other, stick the landing, hips back, trunk tall.
exercises.stop_if: Landing collapse or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Short distances first. Prepares the plant for cutting.

exercises.name: Change-of-direction drill (cones, 5-10-5)
cues: Plant and push on the outside foot, hips low, trunk braced; 60% speed first.
Used as the closed-skill COD standard for both soccer and football.
exercises.stop_if: Twisting pain, sharp pain, or leg symptoms.
exercises.contraindications: Staged speeds: 60%, 80%, then 100%. Planned cuts come after this feels smooth.

exercises.name: Sprints (30-60 m, near-maximal)
cues: Long warm-up with strides; build the speed over several sessions; full recovery between reps.
exercises.stop_if: Pain, tightness, leg symptoms, or loss of form.
exercises.contraindications: Maximal isolated sprints before repeated-sprint work. Full recovery between reps.

exercises.name: Athletic circuit (mixed lifting, jumping, running)
cues: Planned circuit at sport-like intensity with controlled technique.
Include a short soccer or football skill block (shuffles, a planned cut or two, a deceleration) once those items are unlocked.
exercises.stop_if: Pain, leg symptoms, or technical breakdown.
exercises.contraindications: Only at the final level.

exercises.name: Combined soccer and football practice
cues: Optional combined block after both soccer and football drill ladders are at target.
Blend technical soccer work and football movement in one session at the stated effort, still planned and coached, not a live game.
exercises.stop_if: Pain, leg symptoms, or technique breakdown.
exercises.contraindications: Optional. Live games and unplanned collisions are outside the default program.

exercises.name: Lateral shuffle (cone to cone)
cues: Athletic stance, hips low, trunk tall and braced, eyes up.
Short choppy steps; do not cross the feet; stay on the balls of the feet.
Change direction only at the cone, with a planned plant.
exercises.stop_if: Twisting pain, knee cave, loss of posture, or any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Position-agnostic football and soccer footwork. Low impact; start slow.

exercises.name: Backpedal (then plant and go)
cues: Athletic stance, hips back, short steps, eyes up.
Backpedal to a planned mark, plant, then go forward 5 m.
Do not twist the lumbar spine to look; turn the head and the feet together.
exercises.stop_if: Twisting, loss of balance, hamstring tightness, or any back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Football coverage pattern, also useful for soccer defending. Planned marks only at first; no reactive starts until later rungs feel easy.

exercises.name: Planned deceleration to a two-foot stop
cues: Accelerate to the stated effort, then shorten the stride and sit the hips back.
Quiet two-foot stop on a planned mark; trunk tall and braced; hold 2 s.
Do not fold at the waist or let the knees cave.
exercises.stop_if: Stiff or jarring stop, twisting, knee cave, or any back or hamstring symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Soccer and football both need this before cutting or kicking. Planned marks only; no surprise stops.

exercises.name: 45-degree planned cuts
cues: Approach at the stated effort, plant the outside foot, and push off into a 45-degree change.
Trunk stays over the hips; no spinning or lumbar twist.
Stick or re-accelerate out of the cut under control.
exercises.stop_if: Twisting pain, knee cave, sharp pain, or any leg or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: First cutting step for soccer and football. Planned cones only; submaximal at L7.

exercises.name: 90-degree planned cuts, then one reactive cut
cues: Same plant mechanics as the 45-degree cut, into a sharper 90-degree change.
Planned cones first. A single partner- or self-called reactive cut is allowed only at the last rungs, after planned 90s are clean.
Hips low, trunk braced, no spinning.
exercises.stop_if: Twisting pain, knee cave, sharp pain, or any leg or back symptom.
exercises.contraindications: Do not start reactive or 180-degree cuts until planned 90s at the target effort are clean the next morning.

exercises.name: Repeated short sprints (RSA)
cues: Run 20-30 m at the stated effort; walk back or take the stated rest (full recovery on early rungs, 20-30 s at target).
The last rep should look like the first; stop the set if speed or form drops sharply.
Used for soccer repeated sprints and football play-to-play efforts.
exercises.stop_if: Hamstring or groin tightness, back symptoms, or form breakdown.
exercises.contraindications: Only after isolated sprints are clean. Quality of the last rep matters more than the count.

exercises.name: Kicking progression (soccer)
cues: Plant foot beside the ball, hips square or slightly open, trunk tall and braced; no lumbar whip.
Early rungs: short, controlled ground passes (inside and instep) only.
Driven shots after about 70% effort is clean. Volleys and longer dead-ball strikes only at the last rungs.
exercises.stop_if: Back pain on the plant or follow-through, groin or hip-flexor sting, or any sharp or electrical symptom.
exercises.contraindications: The plant and brace are the skill. Never a max instep from a dead ball until the last two rungs are clean the next morning.

exercises.name: Contact and collision readiness (football, controlled)
cues: See the contact coming. Hips low, trunk braced, chin tucked; absorb with the legs, not the lumbar spine.
Early rungs: isometric pad or partner holds (3-5 s) in an athletic stance. Then planned, coached pad bumps in a two-foot stance. Later rungs: short-space planned pad work.
Position-agnostic: stance, shed, absorb, and a controlled hinge get-up. No sit-up get-up.
exercises.stop_if: An unexpected hit, any back or neck symptom, dizziness, or loss of control.
exercises.contraindications: Controlled and coached only. Live tackling, unplanned collisions, and open-field hits are not default program items. Clear the gate test before adding any contact in practice, and only with a coach.

exercises.name: Soccer drills (technical, then small-sided)
cues: Start with individual technical work: short passing, receiving, planned cuts and decelerations, then the kicking progression at its current rung.
Progress to small-sided, planned drills (1v1 or 2v2 in a small grid) only after technical work at the target effort is clean.
Full practice intensity is the last rungs, still not a league match.
exercises.stop_if: Pain, leg symptoms, a heavy plant, or technique breakdown.
exercises.contraindications: Non-contact first. Shoulder-to-shoulder challenges wait until football contact-prep is also clean if both sports are trained in the same week.

exercises.name: Football drills (position-agnostic, non-contact then controlled)
cues: Position-agnostic movement: stance and start, acceleration, backpedal, lateral shuffle, planned cuts, and a controlled deceleration.
Non-contact individual and group movement first. Controlled pad work only after `EX_CONTACT_PREP` is at target.
No live tackling and no unplanned open-field collisions in the default program.
exercises.stop_if: Pain, neck or back symptoms, an unexpected hit, or technique breakdown.
exercises.contraindications: Position-agnostic by design. Position skills (route, throw, catch, kick/punt) can be added later as optional items if David wants them.
